NavigationItem.use: List the destinations in one array, each { label, icon, href or onSelect, count, group, current }, and pass it to Drawer, Rail or Bar, which render the items; selected is current, a count in end is count. No codemod rewrites it: rewrite each list by hand.

NavigationItemProps.use: Destination, one item of the array that Bar, Rail and Drawer take, or DrawerDestination, whose icon is optional.

NavList.use: NavList is gone: list the destinations in one array, each { label, icon, href or onSelect, count, group, current }, and pass it to Drawer, Rail or Bar; NavList.Skeleton is skeleton on the form. No codemod rewrites it: its items are elements and a destination is data.
